name: meta
description: Meta skills for this marketplace: route qualified public-source feedback to issues and private-source feedback to local records.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain the marketplace's skills from real runs.
interface.longDescription: Meta skills for the marketplace itself. submit-skill-feedback qualifies feedback from an actual run, then files public-source feedback in the marketplace repository or preserves private-source feedback as an ignored local record.
defaultPrompt: Use $meta:submit-skill-feedback to capture feedback on the marketplace skills this session ran.
